summary: Iteration 7 frontend testing of restructured PlaygroundDetail (left: schematic + read-only CodeViewer; right: LiveEditor with Editor/Terminal tabs + always-visible hardware controls). All specified selectors present, forbidden selectors absent, ordering correct, editor is editable and persists via localStorage key 'embedded-for-kids-code-drafts', reset restores original, terminal tab shows monitor/input (disabled while DISCONNECTED)/clear, hardware controls visible in both tabs, Flash disabled while disconnected, schematic upload/clear works, tutorial tabs switch content, mobile 400x800 renders all key selectors, zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: hardware-unsupported did not render in Chromium (navigator.serial exists). Behaviour is spec-compliant (only shows when unsupported). No action needed.
LiveEditor.jsx: connect() is invoked with baud but useWebSerial hook should be verified to actually accept baud arg – not tested here since headless can't grant serial port picker.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding requires filling name input, clicking 'Beginner' text card, then 'Mulai perjaianan'. To reach module 0 detail: click 'ESP32 Playground' sidebar tab, then 'First Spark' sidebar item, then 'Buka lab interaktif'. All requested selectors verified on desktop 1920x1000 and mobile 400x800.
